answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 583 Country: India Title: Is it permissable in islam to use tabboco in pan? Question: Assalamu alaikum, is it permissable in islam to use tabboco in pan? Answer ID: 583 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 549/J) Using tobacco is permissible in pan (betel leaf). Some ulama regard it as Makrooh-e-Tanzihi (undesirable) but most ulama do not regard it as Makrooh also. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
